disclaimer: These are potential product matches based on your stated preferences, not an underwriting decision or financial advice. Insurers must confirm California availability, eligibility, coverage, and premiums. This is a limited shortlist, not a comparison of the whole market.

featureReasons.online: You prefer starting a quote online; this insurer offers that route.
featureReasons.local_agent: You prefer a local agent; this insurer offers a local agent network.
featureReasons.flexible_terms: You prefer a wider choice of term lengths; this policy offers seven.
featureReasons.limited_pay: You prefer a shorter premium-paying period with lifetime protection.

protective_classic.title: Classic Choice Term
protective_classic.description: Level-premium term coverage with seven term lengths to choose from.
cautions: Age limits vary by term and tobacco use. Exact eligibility requires an insurer review.
Conversion Choice with ExtendCare is not available in California.

state_farm_select.title: Select Term
state_farm_select.description: Term coverage with fixed initial premiums and access to a local State Farm agent.
cautions: Issue-age maximums are 75 for 10 years, 65 for 20 years, and 45 for 30 years.
Conversion options and riders depend on the policy and state.

state_farm_limited_pay.title: Limited Pay Whole Life
state_farm_limited_pay.description: Lifetime protection with scheduled premiums paid over a shorter period, subject to policy terms.
highlights: Coverage continues after scheduled premiums are paid
cautions: A shorter premium-paying period does not mean a shorter coverage period.
Request an illustration to review premiums, coverage, and cash value before comparing costs.

new_york_life_whole.title: Whole Life Insurance
new_york_life_whole.description: Lifetime protection with level premiums and cash value, provided policy requirements are met.
cautions: Dividends are not guaranteed; loans and withdrawals can reduce benefits.
The Chronic Care Rider is not available in California.

notes.text: Include the people you support when discussing your household’s protection needs.
Bring estimates for income needs, outstanding debts, and future expenses to a coverage discussion.
Discuss final expenses or money you want to leave behind alongside your preferred protection period.
Your income range is a starting point; savings, existing coverage, and how long support is needed also need review.
Check the amount and terms of your workplace coverage, including what happens if you change jobs.
Review your current policy before deciding whether additional coverage is needed.
Check your benefits information and personal records to establish what coverage you already have.
Use your selected budget when requesting real quotes. This survey cannot establish the price or affordability of a policy.
